metadata.description: netbrah's fork of speedread, packaged for Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Grok Build.

plugins.name: speedread-netbrah
plugins.description: Read, search and trace code within a token budget: the function around each hit, a big file's skeleton, a symbol's callers, or only what changed. Read-only, no index, no folder to configure. A fork of speedread with request deadlines and bounded memory.
